about: The links between dowiz's systems (docs/research/2026-10-02-system-integration-check.md section 1, same numbering 1..58; lane W-LIVE adds 59-62), each with its CURRENT status re-derived from the tree. TESTED-INMEM = an automated check in this repo (an in-memory route test, a node test or a gate) drives the link from producer to consumer and fails if it breaks; the proof names it. It is NOT a claim that the link works on the live site (operator rule 2026-10-03: verify on the live site with real connections, contracts, schemas, versions and descriptions). `live` is that second, separate claim: null until a read-only probe against the live site (qa-durres) passes, then {kind: "probe", ref: <script>, contract: <contract/schema/version file>, ...}; an in-memory test is never accepted there. Kept honest by tools/gates/integration-matrix.sh. Lane W-INT1, 2026-10-02/03.
